call_points.text: Revenue grew 27% YoY, above the stated 20-25% long-term aspiration.
More than 30 stores planned for FY27; only three opened in Q1.
6 to 10 stores planned in Madhya Pradesh this financial year, starting with Indore, Ujjain and Bhopal.
10 to 12 stores planned in Chhattisgarh this financial year, where three are open.
Bihar was 72% of Q1 revenue, UP 16% and Jharkhand 11%.
EBITDA margin expanded about 89 bps to 10.4% on lower opex from fewer store openings.
Board approved MSKA & Associates LLP, a BDO member firm, as statutory auditor.
Management declined to give state-wise SSSG or UP store-level sales and EBITDA.
Working capital days were not disclosed; management said it does not measure them quarterly.
Management maintains a long-term EBITDA margin guidance band of 8% to 10%.
Inventory was consciously built up to ₹840 crore to counter potential gas shortages and OEM price hikes.
Consumer finance penetration reached ~53% of total sales in FY26.
Retail footprint reached ~9.1 lakh sq ft across 207 stores as of FY26.

timeline.summary: Aditya Vision Limited scheduled a post-Q4FY26 results conference call on May 8, 2026, at 4:30 PM IST with Chairman & MD Yashovardhan Sinha and Whole Time Director Yosham Vardhan.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹625.03 Cr (+28.4% YoY), net profit ₹21.73 Cr (+36.0% YoY).
Aditya Vision released its Q4/FY26 investor presentation outlining 207 total stores, 8% SSSG, and planned FY27 entry into MP.
Aditya Vision Limited shared the audio recording link for its Analysts/Investors Call on Q4FY26 & FY26 results, approved by the Board on May 08, 2026.
Aditya Vision reported FY26 revenue of ₹2,672 Cr and PAT of ₹117 Cr, with 207 stores across 4 states.
Aditya Vision opened its 210th showroom in Buxar, Bihar on May 22, 2026.
On its 31 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Aditya Vision reported revenue of ₹1,193 Cr (+27% YoY), EBITDA of ₹124 Cr at a 10.4% margin and PAT of ₹77 Cr (+40%), with SSSG of 18% and 210 stores.
Aditya Vision opened five new showrooms on October 29, 2026, entering Madhya Pradesh and West Bengal and bringing its total store count to 219.
Aditya Vision reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹586 Cr (+28.1% YoY) and net profit of ₹18 Cr (+45.2% YoY) with 214 stores.
Aditya Vision Limited provided link to audio recording of Analysts/Investors Call on Unaudited Financial Results for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, held on Friday, October 30, 2026.
